messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

The passages do not rank “most important,” but they identify the key signal-integrity-related capabilities for wireless/network-infrastructure applications as digital design and power measurements using VNA, probes, phase-noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [22][24].
- High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [1][3][20].
- PCB material and stackup work includes impedance by TDR, DK/DF extraction, roughness, impedance, crosstalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram analysis [81].
- Signal-integrity modeling/testing includes insertion loss, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [16][81].
- Interface validation includes the transmission channel across Tx package, PCBs, connectors, and Rx package [3].
- Interface testing uses scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [3].
- RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing uses phase-noise analyzers and signal generators [3].
- Power distribution network testing uses oscilloscopes and network analyzers [3].
- ADC/DAC frontend performance testing uses spectrum analyzers and signal generators [3].
- For wireless infrastructure drivers, the cited application pressures include increasing MIMO/beamforming, OTA, more spectrum bands, higher frequencies, expanding bandwidth, and digital design & power [22].

R&S VSE
[[R&S VSE]]（Vector Signal Explorer）是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 PC signal analysis software；在 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]] 中用於 5G NR、LTE、O-RAN U-Plane / PCAP analysis 與 beamforming measurements 的分析端。

R&S VSE › unresolved
- [[R&S VSE]] 正式 product page / specifications / release notes 尚未 ingest。
- O-RAN PCAP Converter 的版本與下載來源未由本來源提供。
- VSE 與 [[VIAVI O-RU Tester]] 的整合界面、file workflow 與 timing constraints 未完整描述。

R&S VSE › 來源中的定位
依 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]]（August 2023）：

- Slide 8 的 VIAVI + R&S O-RU Tester solution 中列出 [[R&S VSE]]。
- Slide 14 標題為 `R&S®VSE Signal analysis software`，描述為 PC analysis software。
- Slide 14 key facts：
  - Supports mobile and wireless communications standards。
  - Fast measurements with parallel analysis。
  - Supporting floating licenses。
  - Control multiple instruments from one PC。
- Slide 15 說 5G NR signal analysis 支援 presets for 5G NR Test models 與 support of all 5G NR measurements。
- Slide 26 說 3GPP Receiver characteristic testing requires throughput calculation，且 BLER 與 Tput parameters implemented to VSE software。
- Slide 35 說 signal analysis with option VSE-K175 有 pre-defined test signals according to WG4.CONF.0 test specification。
- Slide 36 說 VSE software can extract channel decoder results and bitstream of 5G and LTE uplink and downlink signals；beamforming measurements 可用 VSE-K146 在 summary 顯示 phase and magnitude difference。
- Slide 38 說 O-RAN PCAP Converter 可把 captured Ethernet stream 轉成 VSE file format，VSE analyzes the U-Plane data in UL and DL。
- Slide 46 / 48 的 configurations 列出 VSE Basic Edition、FSPC license dongle、VSE-K144、VSE-K146、VSE-K175、VSE-K100、VSE-K104 等項目。

R&S FSWP50 › Phase noise measurements
- Measurement results：SSB phase noise、spurious signals、integrated RMS phase deviation、residual FM、time jitter。
- Offset frequency range：
  - carrier frequency ≤ maximum input frequency − 1 GHz：1 µHz to max. input frequency − carrier frequency。
  - carrier frequency ≥ maximum input frequency − 1 GHz：1 µHz to 1 GHz。
- Signal level range：
  - level setting = high：−20 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
  - level setting = low：−40 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
  - level setting = low 且 I/Q lowpass ≤ 10 MHz：−50 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
- Number of traces：6。
- Phase noise measurement uncertainty 條件：DUT phase noise ≥ 10 dB above phase noise sensitivity of R&S®FSWP。
  - 1 µHz ≤ offset < 10 mHz：1.5 dB nominal。
  - 10 mHz ≤ offset < 1 MHz：< 1.2 dB，σ = 0.4 dB。
  - 1 MHz ≤ offset ≤ 30 MHz：< 1.5 dB，σ = 0.5 dB。
  - 30 MHz < offset：< 3 dB，σ = 1.0 dB。
- Phase noise measurement uncertainty specified values 適用於 offset frequencies ≤ 30 % of signal frequency。
- DUT phase noise 若高於 R&S®FSWP phase noise sensitivity 6 dB 至 10 dB，uncertainty 增加 1 dB。
- Phase noise level measurement uncertainty，條件為 −20 dBm ≤ signal level ≤ 15 dBm，+20 °C to +30 °C：
  - 1 MHz ≤ signal frequency < 8 GHz：< 1 dB。
  - 8 GHz ≤ signal frequency < 18 GHz：< 2 dB。
  - 18 GHz ≤ signal frequency：< 3 dB。

R&S FSWP50 › RF input 與頻率範圍
- Phase noise / AM noise measurements：
  - DC coupled：1 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - AC coupled：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
- With R&S®FSWP-B56G option：
  - DC coupled：1 MHz to 56 GHz。
  - AC coupled：10 MHz to 56 GHz。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Baseband noise measurement frequency range：
  - RF input, AC coupled：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - RF input, DC coupled：10 mHz to 50 GHz。
  - With R&S®FSWP-B56G，RF input AC coupled：10 MHz to 56 GHz。
  - With R&S®FSWP-B56G，RF input DC coupled：10 mHz to 56 GHz。
  - Baseband input：AC coupled 0.3 Hz to 40 MHz 或 100 Hz to 40 MHz；DC coupled 10 mHz to 40 MHz。
- Transient analysis frequency range：
  - DC coupled：1 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - AC coupled：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
- Allan deviation / Allan variance frequency range：1 MHz to 50 GHz。

R&S FSWP50 › Spectrum analyzer、bandwidth 與 frequency extension options
| Option code | 名稱 | Order No. | 原文說明 / 限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&S®FSWP-B1 | Spectrum analyzer, 10 Hz to 50 GHz | 1322.9997.50 | for R&S®FSWP50 |
| R&S®FSWP-B8 | Resolution bandwidth up to 80 MHz | 1325.5028.02 | not retrofittable，for R&S®FSWP50 with R&S®FSWP-B80 option；export license required |
| R&S®FSWP-B21 | LO/IF connections for external mixers | 1325.3848.02 | retrofittable，for R&S®FSWP26/50，contact service center，includes two cables for IF and LO ports, length 1 m |
| R&S®FSWP-B24 | RF preamplifier, 100 kHz to 50 GHz | 1325.3725.50 | for R&S®FSWP50 |
| R&S®FSWP-B56G | Frequency extension up to 56 GHz | 1357.7878.02 | retrofittable，for R&S®FSWP50 with model .51 或 R&S®FSWP-B61 option model .51 |
| R&S®FSWP-B80 | 80 MHz analysis bandwidth | 1325.4338.02 | retrofittable，for R&S®FSWP8/26/50 |
| R&S®FSWP-B320 | 320 MHz analysis bandwidth | 1338.3235.04 | retrofittable，for R&S®FSWP8/26/50 |

- R&S®FSWP-B1 spectrum analyzer mode：DC coupled 10 Hz to 50 GHz；AC coupled 10 MHz to 50 GHz；with R&S®FSWP-B56G 時 DC coupled 1 MHz to 56 GHz，AC coupled 10 MHz to 56 GHz。
- Signal analysis bandwidth：standard 10 MHz nominal；with R&S®FSWP-B80 option 80 MHz nominal；with R&S®FSWP-B320 option 320 MHz nominal。
- R&S®FSWP-B24 RF preamplifier frequency range：100 kHz to 50 GHz；RF preamplifier gain setting range 15 dB / 30 dB nominal；RF preamplifier 對 phase noise analyzer specifications 無影響。
- R&S®FSWP-B320：signal analysis bandwidth 標稱 320 MHz；f ≥ 8 GHz 時 YIG preselector off。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。
- `R&S®SMW-K144`：5G New Radio，Order No. `1414.4990.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K145`：5G New Radio closed-loop BS test，Order No. `1414.6506.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。
- Multichannel、MIMO and fading 完整規格另見 `PD 3673.1276.22`；digital standards 完整規格另見 `PD 5213.9434.22`；GNSS/avionics 另見 `PD 3607.6896.22`；Pulse Sequencer 另見 `PD 3607.1388.22`。

R&S SMW200A › Unresolved
- 來源未標示價格。
- 本頁整合 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（configuration guide，May 2024）與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（specifications，May 2026）；兩者文件性質不同。報價前應回查正式 PDF、最新 ordering information 與 configure 工具。
- Multichannel、MIMO、fading、digital standards、GNSS/avionics、external pulse sequencer options 的完整規格需另查引用文件：`PD 3673.1276.22`、`PD 5213.9434.22`、`PD 3607.6896.22`、`PD 3607.1388.22`。
- RF path combination table 的全部 allowed / not allowed combinations 與灰底 deeper chassis 條件需回查原表；本頁只照錄來源明列摘要與 `R&S®SMW-B94L` 明列條件。

- 來源為分段萃取重點，不是完整逐頁文字；圖表曲線僅記錄來源明列的文字與數字。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。

Reverberation chamber OTA testing
[[Reverberation chamber OTA testing]] 是在會大量反射 RF signal 的 chamber 中進行 over-the-air 測試，藉由形成 [[Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment]] 來評估 wireless devices 的 antenna and radio performance。

Reverberation chamber OTA testing › 與 anechoic chamber 的差異
來源只提供高層次差異：anechoic test chambers 與 reverberation chambers 不同；reverberation chambers 透過 RF signal 反射形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment。來源未提供 anechoic chamber 的詳細定義、吸波材料規格、direct path isolation、test correlation 或標準化測試方法比較。

- Signal-integrity modeling/testing includes insertion loss, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [16][81].
- Interface validation includes the transmission channel across Tx package, PCBs, connectors, and Rx package [3].
- Interface testing uses scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [3].
- RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing uses phase-noise analyzers and signal generators [3].
- Power distribution network testing uses oscilloscopes and network analyzers [3].
- ADC/DAC frontend performance testing uses spectrum analyzers and signal generators [3].
- For wireless infrastructure drivers, the cited application pressures include increasing MIMO/beamforming, OTA, more spectrum bands, higher frequencies, expanding bandwidth, and digital design & power [22].
